cohort: Angular cohort two, cell C2 (Angular 8 pre-Ivy ViewEngine)

candidate.expectationSource: a prior read-only scout unit (lrapr-t006/u14, 2026-08-11); every claim is re-verified from the wire by this unit rather than trusted
candidate.substitutionForbidden: This unit may ingest this candidate or nothing. pigallery2 1.7.0 is a PM-ruled fallback but stays un-ingested unless the PM re-rules.

network.mode: VERSIONLESS_NETWORK_MODE=consented, acquisition only; offline thereafter except the package-manager baseline window recorded below

gitProtocolDependencyAllowlist.ruling: PM-RULED APPROVED under consent VL-LEGACY-CORPUS-2026-08-10. A git-protocol dependency is admitted provided its resolved commit and a tree/tarball digest are recorded per the closure idiom, and the absence of any registry integrity hash is recorded as found rather than repaired.
gitProtocolDependencyAllowlist.note: The resolved commit is read out of the acquired yarn.lock, not chosen by this unit.

requiredRevisionWindow.rationale: The Angular 8 pre-Ivy ViewEngine era. A revision outside this window would not fill the era gap this cell exists for.

admissionGates: MIT licence text present in the tree at the pinned revision, verified from the acquired bytes
a real substantive application, not a demo or a tutorial scaffold
an era-coherent commit date inside the required revision window
at least three substantive user journeys plausible from the acquired source
gateFailurePolicy: Any gate failing is recorded append-only in this evidence root and the unit returns blocked. No substitute candidate is acquired.

baselineNetwork.purpose: one truthful baseline dependency install and one production browser build attempt for the declared legacy cell
baselineNetwork.buildScope: the web application build only. The Electron sidecar is explicitly out of build scope for this unit and is recorded, not exercised.
baselineNetwork.note: Package-manager fetches during the baseline install are performed by the package manager itself and are recorded in aggregate in the baseline attempt record, not URL-by-URL in the source ledger.

nonclaims: Starting this transaction establishes no tag identity, licence, source integrity, dependency closure, framework, build, browser behavior, migration feasibility, pilot status, or production readiness.
The resulting evidence is reproducibility evidence, not certification or legal approval.
